Pumpkin oat biscuits

Sütőtökös keksz

7 months+ Adjusted 22 min 10 portions

Serve soft, thick pieces. Leave them out of the oven before the edges dry.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 150 g Pumpkin puree (Cooked and unsweetened)
  • 100 g Rolled oats (Fine oats stay softer)
  • 1 tablespoon Mild oil (Keeps the rounds tender)

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  2. Mix the pumpkin, oats, and oil.
  3. Press thick small rounds onto a lined tray.
  4. Bake until just set and still soft, about 14 minutes.
  5. Cool under a cloth so they do not harden.

Adjusted

Honey sometimes sweetens this kind of bake, and honey is not used. A dry, hard biscuit is not the aim.

Bake pumpkin and oats into soft biscuits with no honey and no sugar.
